adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-adjudication completed for the Tasmanian devil cathelicidin paper. Primary material supports six mature peptide sequences, the Table 2 MIC matrix for Saha-CATH3/5/6, and Figure 4/text toxicity summaries. Cross-database conflicts were preserved rather than smoothed, leaving the paper accepted with cautions but publication-grade under obtainable-only local evidence.
